# Complex plan

Use [plan fields](plan.md). Add verified context, current/target architecture, boundary ownership, contract/data changes, key decisions and rejected alternatives, and requirement-to-verification traceability.

Cover applicable failure, retry, migration, rollback, security/privacy, accessibility, performance, and observability constraints. Specify user-visible behavior when present. Diagram non-trivial state or cross-module flows. Keep risks concrete and mitigation testable.
